consumers: 3L0 plane (collaborator-class entity outcomes, cross-access via repo artifacts)

method.belief: per-entity Gaussian talent belief theta ~ N(mu, sigma), Glicko/TrueSkill family; Elo-style updates shrinking with sigma (Delphi/3L0 pattern consumed by reference: Elo k=16, EWMA alpha 0.2)
method.cold_start: mu = field mean or global prior; sigma = sigma_max; v = 1; forecast no-signal until thresholds cross; belief carries across events, per-event fit re-derived

forecast_output.rule: unknowns u = unscored share, v = unverified axis weight share; k = clamp(0.6u + 0.4v, 0.05, 0.95); range = [est(1-k), est(1+k)]; never a silent point; below any-signal thresholds -> estimate null, confidence none (no-signal)
forecast_output.shape: {estimate|null, range|[lo,hi], confidence high|medium|low|none, prior{}, standing{}, fit{}, unknowns{u,v,k}, basis, computed_at}

method.name: talent-forecast/v1
method.prior: seeded from MoneyBall v2 composite (axes track_record .30, momentum .25, engagement_surface .20, composability_fit .15, inverse_engagement_cost .10, fixed at event intake) mapped onto the scored-field composite distribution; no v2 record -> field prior, sigma = sigma_max
method.standing: percentile vs scored-field composite distribution, Laplace form — consumes winprob/v2 standing block, does not fork it
updates: placement/win/finalist = ordinal observation vs scored field
3L0 elo/gate-pass outcomes for collaborator-class entities, read from repo artifacts only
method.visibility: Admin panel only (challenge-admin-metrics feed family); never public feeds/pages/briefs/ledger; no forecast-derived EV anywhere
